claim: Patchline ships an information-bottleneck feature study bounding minimal sufficient features per hazard class. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the information bottleneck claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make information-bottleneck-features-gate`.
